source:
characters:
  - id: character.iris_vale
    name: Iris Vale
    role: investigator
    occupation: Private detective
    description: Iris notices what everyone else edits out.
    narrator_guidance:
      goal: Find the missing ledger before dawn.
  - id: character.victor_march
    name: Victor March
    role: suspect
    occupation: Nightclub owner
    description: Victor owns the room and every secret whispered in it.
    testimony:
      - id: testimony.victor_bar_alibi
        text: Claims he never left the bar.
        requires: [command.question, character.victor_march]
  - id: character.mara_voss
    name: Mara Voss
    role: culprit
    description: Calm, exacting, and indispensable; Mara knows every lock, circuit, and service passage on the island.
    portrayal:
      demeanor: Controlled and professionally helpful.
      speech_style: Precise, restrained sentences.
    narrator_guidance:
      goal: SENTINEL_PRIVATE_MARA_GOAL
      testimony_guidance:
        under_pressure: SENTINEL_PRIVATE_MARA_PRESSURE
    testimony:
      - id: testimony.mara_generator_alibi
        text: Mara says she was in the generator shed from 21:10 onward.
        requires: [command.question, character.mara_voss, event.blackout]
        reveals: [fact.mara_claimed_generator_alibi]
    facts:
      - id: fact.mara_claimed_generator_alibi
        statement: At 21:10 on day 0, Mara claimed she was in the generator shed from that time onward.
        occurred_at:
          day: 0
          time: "21:10"
        author_notes:
          future_metadata: SENTINEL_FUTURE_CHARACTER_FACT_METADATA
      - id: fact.mara_borrowed_degreaser
        statement: Mara borrowed the citrus degreaser from Theo after dinner.
    author_notes:
      future_character_metadata: SENTINEL_FUTURE_MARA_METADATA
  - id: character.theo_bell
    name: Theo Bell
    role: witness
    description: Warm and theatrical in the dining room, but visibly anxious whenever Rowan discusses the retreat's finances.
    portrayal:
      demeanor: Warm and cooperative when discussing kitchen routines.
      speech_style: Expressive but direct, with concrete details.
    testimony:
      - id: testimony.theo_mara_borrowed_degreaser
        text: Theo says Mara borrowed the citrus degreaser after dinner. He marked the bottle "Mara — return" before lending it to her.
        requires: [command.question, character.theo_bell, entity.degreaser_bottle]
        reveals: [fact.mara_borrowed_degreaser]

entities:
  - id: entity.missing_ledger
    name: Missing ledger
    type: document
    initial:
      container: setting.backstage
    description: Several pages have been torn out.
    author_notes:
      initial_condition: Water damaged
    facts:
      - id: fact.ledger_is_missing
        statement: At 23:45 on day 0, the recovered ledger was water-damaged and several pages were missing.
        occurred_at:
          day: 0
          time: "23:45"
        author_notes:
          future_metadata: SENTINEL_FUTURE_FACT_METADATA
        about: [entity.missing_ledger]
  - id: entity.degreaser_bottle
    name: Citrus degreaser
    type: cleaning_supply
    initial:
      container: setting.backstage
    description: A bottle marked for Mara.
  - id: entity.display_box
    name: Display box
    description: A locked display box.
    initial:
      container: setting.backstage
  - id: entity.hidden_gun
    name: Hidden gun
    description: A compact handgun hidden in the display box.
    physical:
      portable: true
    initial:
      container: entity.display_box
    visibility:
      requires: flag.box_open
  - id: entity.bookshelf
    name: Bookshelf
    description: A fixed bookshelf filled with nightclub ledgers.
    initial:
      container: setting.backstage
  - id: entity.car
    name: Town car
    description: A black town car waiting behind the club.
    initial:
      container: setting.backstage

case:
  id: case.last_call
  format_version: "3.4.0"
  title: Last Call
  initial_time: "23:50"
  players:
    min: 1
    max: 4
  entry_settings:
    - setting.backstage
  exit_settings:
    - setting.service_entrance
  ruleset:
    id: ruleset.standard_mystery
    version: 4.0.0
solution:
  win_state: win.solve_questions
  questions:
    - prompt: Who committed the crime?
      answer:
        - character.iris_vale
    - prompt: Where and with what?
      answer:
        - entity.missing_ledger
        - setting.backstage
      ordered: true

settings:
  - id: setting.service_entrance
    name: Service entrance
    type: doorway
    description: A narrow entrance beside the rain-soaked alley.
    facts:
      - id: fact.service_entrance_was_rainy
        statement: At 23:40 on day 0, rain reached the service entrance.
        occurred_at:
          day: 0
          time: "23:40"
        author_notes:
          future_metadata: SENTINEL_FUTURE_SETTING_FACT_METADATA
  - id: setting.backstage
    name: Backstage corridor
    type: passage
    description: A cramped hallway behind the club's main stage.
routes:
  - id: route.service_entrance_backstage
    from: setting.service_entrance
    to: setting.backstage
    bidirectional: true
    travel_minutes: 2

win_states:
  - id: win.solve_case
    name: Solved the Island Retreat mystery
    requires: [deduction.hidden_payment]
    minimum_points: 12
    text: You proved who committed the murder and staged the blackout.
  - id: win.solve_questions
    name: Solved the Island Retreat mystery
    text: You proved who committed the murder and staged the blackout.

deductions:
  - id: deduction.hidden_payment
    conclusion: Victor concealed the nightclub's final payment.
    inputs: [fact.ledger_is_missing, fact.hidden_payment]
    truth: true
  - id: deduction.cover_up
    conclusion: Iris used the hidden payment to stage a cover-up.
    inputs: [deduction.hidden_payment, fact.ledger_is_missing]
    truth: true

events:
  - id: event.last_call
    day: 0
    time: "23:45"
    duration_minutes: 15
    location: setting.service_entrance
    participants:
      - character.iris_vale
      - character.victor_march
    summary: Iris confronts Victor before last call.
    facts:
      - id: fact.last_call_confrontation
        statement: At 23:45 on day 0, Iris confronted Victor at the service entrance.
        occurred_at:
          day: 0
          time: "23:45"
        author_notes:
          future_metadata: SENTINEL_FUTURE_EVENT_FACT_METADATA
  - id: event.blackout
    day: 0
    time: "23:48"
    duration_minutes: 1
    location: setting.backstage
    participants:
      - character.mara_voss
    summary: The lights fail briefly.

flags:
  - id: flag.ledger_found
    name: Ledger found
    description: The missing nightclub ledger has been recovered.
    initial_state: false
  - id: flag.ledger_analysis_complete
    name: Ledger analysis complete
    description: The delayed ledger analysis has completed.
    initial_state: false
  - id: flag.box_open
    name: Box open
    description: The display box has been opened.
    initial_state: false

triggers:
  - id: trigger.examine_ledger
    name: Find the hidden payment
    on:
      command: command.examine
      parameters:
        target: entity.missing_ledger
    once: true
    when:
      all:
        - time:
            relation: after
            value: "23:00"
        - at: setting.backstage
    after: 20m
    facts:
      - id: fact.ledger_analysis_was_started
        statement: At 23:50 on day 0, the delayed ledger analysis was started.
        occurred_at:
          day: 0
          time: "23:50"
        author_notes:
          future_metadata: SENTINEL_FUTURE_TRIGGER_FACT_METADATA
      - id: fact.hidden_payment
        statement: The torn ledger records Victor's final payment at 20:15 on day 0.
        about: [entity.missing_ledger, character.victor_march]
        occurred_at:
          day: 0
          time: "20:15"
